rclone-backfill.description: Existing archives to replicate when replication is first enabled.
rclone-backfill.title: Backfill

rclone-bwlimit.description: Upload bandwidth limit in rclone syntax, optionally a timetable such as "08:00,1M 23:00,off".
rclone-bwlimit.title: Upload Bandwidth Limit

rclone-delete-grace.description: Deleted offsite backups are kept as tombstones for this long and can be restored.
rclone-delete-grace.title: Delete Grace Period

rclone-encryption.description: Client-side encryption of the repository (rclone crypt).
rclone-encryption.title: Encryption

rclone-guests.description: Which guests are replicated: all, guests carrying one of rclone-tags, or rclone-vmids.
rclone-guests.title: Guests

rclone-immutable.description: Refuse every deletion of offsite backups.
rclone-immutable.title: Immutable

rclone-keep-min.description: Retention keeps at least this many complete, verified backups per guest.
rclone-keep-min.title: Keep Minimum

rclone-max-deletes.description: Maximum number of backups a single retention run may delete.
rclone-max-deletes.title: Maximum Deletions

rclone-min-age.description: Retention never deletes offsite backups younger than this.
rclone-min-age.title: Minimum Age

rclone-min-interval.description: Skip an archive if the guest already has an offsite backup newer than this (e.g. 7d).
rclone-min-interval.title: Minimum Interval

rclone-path.description: Repository base path inside the remote.
rclone-path.title: Repository Path

rclone-remote.description: Name of the transport remote configured with 'pve-rclone-backup remote add'.
rclone-remote.title: Remote

rclone-replicate-from.description: Local backup storages whose finished archives are replicated. Empty disables replication.
rclone-replicate-from.title: Replicate From

rclone-segment-size.description: Size of the segments archives are split into.
rclone-segment-size.title: Segment Size

rclone-source.description: Namespace of this Proxmox VE installation inside the repository.
rclone-source.title: Source Name

rclone-supersede.description: Drop queued, not yet started uploads of older archives of the same guest.
rclone-supersede.title: Supersede

rclone-tags.description: Guest tags selecting guests when rclone-guests is "tagged".
rclone-tags.title: Tags

rclone-verify-budget.description: Maximum bytes downloaded per day for content verification.
rclone-verify-budget.title: Content Verify Budget

rclone-verify-content.description: Interval of rolling download-based verification, or "off".
rclone-verify-content.title: Content Verify Interval

rclone-verify-interval.description: Interval of listing-based verification (presence and provider checksums).
rclone-verify-interval.title: Verify Interval
